items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Moten, Mary Lou Williams, and Dizzy Gillespie, five of us.

ctx.x: Bennie Moten, Mary Lou Williams, and Dizzy Gillespie, five of us. But it was the way in which they did it. It was a big deal. I know they must have spent a fortune doing it, had a party and Gloria Vanderbilt, her husband, and the Hallmark people were sponsoring the Charlie Parker Foundation.
Were they the sponsors for it?
